# pi-gap-index

> Measured gaps in the public Pi surface, with reference specs. Read-only. No writes, no keys, no
> submission. Adoption is `not-claimed`.

## One-line answers

- What is this? An index of **measured** deficits in the public Pi developer surface, each with a
  reproducible probe, a reference specification, and conformance tests.
- Does it claim Pi will adopt anything? **No.** Adoption is `not-claimed`.
- Does it claim to be first? **No.** It says "no prior work found".
- Does it submit proposals? **No.** Submission is the owner's action.
- Does it write to the network? **No.** Every probe is read-only.
- What are the gaps? G1 no public Mainnet Soroban RPC; G2 Horizon HAL links are RFC 6570 templates
  (naive call returns 404); G3 event reads silently truncated (cap 100, limit ignored, endLedger
  exclusive, retention 120,960); G4 the official proposal channel publishes no acceptance process;
  G5 no compatibility contract for the RPC surface; G6 Mainnet contract capability announced but not
  observed in the window.
- What did the channel measurement show? 94 open PRs, 23 closed, **0 merged**, a 2-line ReadMe, last
  content push 2026-04-17. This describes a channel, not anyone's intent.
- What is the reference spec? SPEC-001: a read-only compatibility contract requiring explicit
  truncation signals, a reported effective limit, stated `endLedger` exclusivity, and a returned
  retention window.
- How do I check it? `node gaps.mjs --probe` (live, read-only) and `node test/run.mjs` (offline).
- Does it review external claims? Yes — `docs/EXTERNAL-CLAIM-REVIEW.md` checks a public Pi economic
  model claim by claim, with verdicts `matches` / `contradicts` / `uncheckable-here` / `out-of-scope`.
  It names no author, makes no intent claim, and produces no price.

## Commands (zero-dependency)

```
node gaps.mjs --list          # measured gap registry
node gaps.mjs --gap G1        # one gap in detail
node gaps.mjs --channel       # measured channel state
node gaps.mjs --readiness     # readiness ladder
node gaps.mjs --boundaries    # what this repo refuses to claim
node gaps.mjs --probe         # run the read-only probes
node test/run.mjs             # offline invariants
```

## Claim kinds

Every statement is exactly one of: `measured` · `documented` · `external` · `not-claimed`.

## Never claimed

Adoption, endorsement, obligation, priority, or novelty. No prediction that any proposal is merged.
